name: Watch Walton and Hersham FC
summary: Support the Swans at the Elmbridge Xcel Sports Hub for a friendly, inclusive taste of local football. The main stand seats around 500, including wheelchair viewing positions, with a catering unit, two bars and a club shop on matchdays.
reasonToVisit: A friendly, sociable home fixture for Walton and Hersham FC
planningDetail: Enter from Waterside Drive; the stadium car park fills quickly, so arrive early or use the main Xcel car park
